attorneys: Deputy Solicitor General Roberts argued the cause for the United States. On the briefs were Solicitor General Starr, Assistant Attorney General Mueller, Deputy Solicitor General Bryson, Robert A. Long, Jr., and Nina Goodman., Joseph R. Conte argued the cause and filed a brief for respondent.*

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The Court is advised that the respondent died in Washington, D. C., on March 24, 1993. The Court’s order granting the writ of certiorari, see 504 U. S. 908 (1992), therefore is vacated, and the petition for certiorari is dismissed. See Mintzes v. Buchanon, 471 U. S. 154 (1985).

It is so ordered.
